messages:
Maya: monitoring alerted 1: EU embeddings throughput degraded. Product wants coordinated customer comms: status page, in-app banner, targeted enterprise email, and a short social post. aiming to publish initial note at 09:20 PT. @Priya can you draft?

Priya: Draft statuspage (Investigating)
``" + "Status: Investigating
Summary: Customers in EU may see slower embeddings throughput and occasional timeouts.
Impact: Batch embeddings and high-volume jobs affected; interactive calls mostly unaffected.
What we\u2019re doing: Engineers deploying a targeted fix and monitoring. No customer data exposure detected.
Next update: 30 minutes or when partial recovery observed.
Link: https://status.redwood.ai
" + "``

Diego CS: include explicit "no customer data was exposed" line in email and status. Send email only to Dedicated/Private customers and large-enterprise contacts.

Ava Eng: patch rolling to subset of hosts now. partial recovery expected ~30-45m; full recovery target ~90m. will post 50% and mitigated updates here.

Maya: timing: 09:20 PT statuspage, 09:21 PT in-app banner, 09:25 PT enterprise email, 09:22 PT X post linking to status. Is that doable?

Jon Ops: i can monitor the window and alert if we go beyond 90m.

Priya: in-app banner text: "Embeddings throughput in EU is currently degraded — investigating. See status.redwood.ai for updates."

Diego CS: prepping canned replies (rerun guidance + priority support contact).

StatusBot: Draft status entry queued to staging (ID: stg-10123). Preview: https://status.redwood.ai/staging/stg-10123

Maya: thanks — I will publish at 09:20 PT. team stand by for the 09:50 PT check-in to confirm mitigation. :white_check_mark:

Ava Eng: will post here when throughput >50% recovered.
